The inner ring, labeled “Max Ambiguity (Inner),” is split into three segments: 39.0% for Max: 1 (darkest blue), 14.2% for Max: 2 (medium blue), and 38.0% for Max: 3 (lightest blue). The chart includes a legend on the right side that maps each color to its respective metric value, and percentages are directly labeled within each segment of the ring.
